metadata.description: Synthetic multi-repository cloud platform for analytics, distributed services, and developer tooling.

clusters.name: Core Services & Backend APIs
clusters.description: Foundational backend services, microservices, gRPC/REST APIs, authentication, and core business engines.

clusters.name: Frontend & User Interfaces
clusters.description: Client applications, web portals, dashboards, mobile apps, and interactive UI component design systems.

clusters.name: Developer Tooling & SDKs
clusters.description: Client SDKs, CLI utilities, code generators, testing harnesses, linters, plugins, and agent skills.

clusters.name: Data Engineering & AI/ML
clusters.description: Data pipelines, ETL workflows, stream processing, machine learning models, and analytics infrastructure.

clusters.name: Infrastructure & DevOps
clusters.description: Cloud infrastructure as code, Kubernetes deployment manifests, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and monitoring.

clusters.name: Shared Libraries & Utilities
clusters.description: Common utilities, protocol definitions, shared data contracts, helper packages, and cross-cutting libraries.

clusters.name: Documentation & Specifications
clusters.description: Architectural blueprints, technical documentation, API specifications, guides, and project roadmaps.

repositories.name: terravic-api-gateway
repositories.description: High-performance edge reverse proxy and authentication gateway routing traffic to core microservices.
repositories.readme_summary: Core API Gateway handling SSL termination, rate limiting, and JWT authentication across all external ingress points.

repositories.name: terravic-auth-service
repositories.description: OAuth2 / OIDC identity provider and token management service with RBAC enforcement.
repositories.readme_summary: Identity and access management engine offering multi-factor authentication, session rotation, and JWT signing.

repositories.name: terravic-user-service
repositories.description: User profiles, tenant management, and organization membership service.
repositories.readme_summary: Manages tenant hierarchies, user metadata, preferences, and billing account associations.

repositories.name: terravic-billing-engine
repositories.description: Subscription lifecycle, usage meter aggregation, and Stripe payment webhook processing service.
repositories.readme_summary: Asynchronous billing service that ingests usage events and manages automated invoice generation.

repositories.name: terravic-web-portal
repositories.description: Customer facing web portal and administration console built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
repositories.readme_summary: Modern administrative and customer dashboard featuring analytics graphs, API key management, and team settings.

repositories.name: terravic-design-system
repositories.description: Reusable React component library, design tokens, and Storybook documentation.
repositories.readme_summary: Standardized accessible component primitives, accessible modal systems, and color tokens.

repositories.name: terravic-mobile-app
repositories.description: Cross-platform mobile application for incident notifications and operational metrics.
repositories.readme_summary: React Native companion app providing push notifications for system alerts and tenant health metrics.

repositories.name: terravic-data-pipeline
repositories.description: Distributed real-time streaming pipeline and ETL workers aggregating telemetry events into data warehouse.
repositories.readme_summary: Scalable ingestion engine processing 100k events/sec using Kafka topics and materialized analytical views.

repositories.name: terravic-ai-engine
repositories.description: LLM inference orchestrator, vector embeddings pipeline, and automated anomaly detection model.
repositories.readme_summary: Retrieval-augmented intelligence service extracting system insights and predictive telemetry anomalies.

repositories.name: terravic-js-sdk
repositories.description: Official TypeScript and JavaScript client SDK for integrating with Terravic platform APIs.
repositories.readme_summary: Type-safe client bindings with automatic retry, token refresh, and streaming subscription support.

repositories.name: terravic-python-sdk
repositories.description: Python SDK and CLI client for automation scripts, data science workloads, and backend integration.
repositories.readme_summary: Asyncio-ready Python client with Pydantic model serialization and structured error handling.

repositories.name: terravic-cli
repositories.description: Developer command-line interface for provisioning environments, deploying jobs, and managing tokens.
repositories.readme_summary: Cross-platform CLI tool for CI/CD runners and local developer sandbox provisioning.

repositories.name: terravic-core-lib
repositories.description: Shared proto definitions, middleware contracts, structured logging, and telemetry utilities.
repositories.readme_summary: Shared foundation library providing protobuf definitions, standard error types, and tracing interceptors.

repositories.name: terravic-infrastructure
repositories.description: Terraform modules, Kubernetes Helm charts, and GitOps ArgoCD manifests for cloud environments.
repositories.readme_summary: Infrastructure-as-code repository managing production Kubernetes clusters, VPC networking, and RDS databases.

repositories.name: terravic-docs
repositories.description: Developer guides, OpenAPI specifications, architecture RFCs, and deployment blueprints.
repositories.readme_summary: Public and internal technical documentation portal containing API references, architecture decision records, and onboarding guides.
